input.summary:
Dairy Chiller at Ikeja Depot Shop: 4 of 6 planogram SKUs at expected facings; 2 stocked out (Three Crowns Evaporated Milk 160g, 0 of 4; Dano Cool Cow Milk 400g, 0 of 3). Compliance 67%, planogram share 100%, no unknown products.

Inventory check: Three Crowns on_hand 6 (reorder point 6), Dano on_hand 4 (reorder point 6). Both at or below reorder point, so I proposed one case (12 units) of each - Three Crowns to 18 units (~₦4,800) and Dano to 16 units (~₦36,000), covering expected facings x3 plus the reorder point.

Because some back-stock exists for both, the immediate fix is a shelf refill: I notified the manager via WhatsApp to restock both slots from back-stock today, noting back-stock alone will not hold full facings until the cases arrive.

No telemetry was available for this chiller and the photo showed no visible damage, so no technician was dispatched; the manager was asked to confirm the unit is cooling.

Escalating: audit confidence is 0.74 (below comfortable) with an ambiguous "multi" auditor note, so a human should eyeball the shelf/photo before the orders are released.
